about_the_game:
This book contains concept arts and 'Behind The Scenes' of The Hungry Lamb.

It contains:  

  • Chapter 1: The background of the world where the story took place in.

  • Chapter 2: Character Design, portraits, emoticons, designer comments, references, draft, etc.

  • Chapter 3: Storylines, collection of scenes, dialogues and descriptions in finer details,

including both main and branching storylines.

File format: PDF, additional software may be required. The PDF file will be delivered alongside the original game, which can be found in the game's folders  

On Steam, you can right-click the name on Library view, choose Manage -> Browse local files to navigate to the installation path.
